note: Thin package pages: noindex, follow and left out of the sitemap. The live URL is noindexed, whether that is /apps/<name>.html or the winning tutorial. Add real content (data/enrichment.json or data/app-extras.json) and remove the name here to index it again.
rule: A page counts as thin when all of these hold: (1) it is generated only from package database facts, with no reviewed description, no screenshot, no demo video and no hand written FAQ or guide; (2) the package was added to the repo more than 30 days ago; (3) Search Console page data for the last 90 days (Aug 10 to Nov 7, 2026 PT, web search) shows no clicks and under 30 impressions. The 9 Nov 2026 audit also noindexes generated X on Omarchy templates that have 0 clicks and under 30 impressions in that window. Hand guides, the homepage, leaderboard, press and flea, strata, slap-notes-bin and omarchy-task-manager are never listed.
